requirements.description: The Radio Button Example offers Radio1, Radio2 and Radio3, and none is selected when the page opens.
Selecting a radio button selects only that option and clears the previous selection.
Clicking a radio button that is already selected leaves that selection in place.

testCases.title: Radio group starts with three options and none selected

steps.action: Read the Radio Button Example legend and option labels
Inspect the checked state of Radio1, Radio2 and Radio3

testCases.expectedResult: The group shows Radio1, Radio2 and Radio3, and none of them is selected.

testCases.title: Selecting another radio clears the previous selection
preconditions: Automation Practice page is open and no radio is selected
testCases.expectedResult: Only Radio3 is selected. Radio1 and Radio2 are not selected.

testCases.title: Clicking the selected radio keeps that radio selected
testCases.expectedResult: Radio3 stays selected and Radio1 and Radio2 stay unselected.
